caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with an ornate wooden casing in various shades of dark brown, featuring intricate carvings and detailing near the top and base. The clock face is square and golden-yellow in color, with Roman numerals marking the hours and two hands, one for the hour and one for the minute, both in a dark blue or black color. At the top of the clock face, there is an arched section with additional decorative gold detailing. The clock’s door occupies the middle to lower portion of the case, with a small round glass window allowing a view of the internal pendulum. The wood grain is visible on the clock’s surface, and the entire case stands on a rectangular plinth with decorative molding at the base. The background is a plain, light beige color with faint signs of wear or age visible in some areas.
title: Grandfather Clock
